issues.on_page: Statement of Activities functions: General government 879,041; Fair 335,181; Capital projects 102,336
issues.issue: All object lines from the Total column are under agriculture/fair. The report's own function split puts the Sinking Fund (capital projects) at 102,336, of which only the 24,000 Capital outlay line is under capital outlay. Repairs and maintenance 27,067, wages 48,558 and equipment rental 1,676 in the Sinking Fund are counted as agriculture/fair. This is defensible for an agricultural society but is a judgment call.

Per the ag-society rule, fair revenue takes detail 'fair/event revenue'. On p4, Ticket sales 64,607 + Carnival 34,622 + Concession sales 197,235 = 296,464 (64% of the group), so 'fair/event revenue' may fit better.
Sales tax collected and owed to the state could be 'due to other governments'.
ending_cash and beginning_cash hold the modified-cash fund balance, not the cash (cash is 518,698 less liabilities 9,761). Marked computed and explained in notes; the roll-forward reconciles.
